# /crav1-tasks-ready-to-build

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [Tasks ready to build](../../from-tasks-ready-to-build.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-tasks-ready-to-build/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

List the tasks ready to build, for one spec or all, and why the others are blocked. Read-only.

**[`/crav1-tasks-ready-to-build`](crav1-tasks-ready-to-build.md)** reads `spec.md` open questions, `plan.md` (the `Reviewed:` line and `## Risks`), `tasks.md`, and `verify.md` for one slice or every slice. A ticked task is Done when `verify.md` lists it as verified, otherwise Needs verify. Then a task is blocked by a missing `plan.md`, by a kept-open question whose `Blocks:` line names it, by a kept-open question or plan Risk with no `Blocks:` line (the whole slice, inferred), or by an unticked task in its `(after: T#)` (recorded) or, with no `(after: …)`, any earlier unticked task (inferred). Otherwise it is Ready, with a warning when the plan review is unknown (inferred) or still has open `P#`s.

Shows summary counts per slice, then Ready, Blocked (one reason each, recorded or inferred), Needs verify, a Done count, `Next: [`/crav1-build-tasks`](crav1-build-tasks.md) T#`, and a `Source:` line. Local only: it never reads Azure Boards and names [`/crav1-ado-sync`](crav1-ado-sync.md) for task states there. It writes nothing and runs no other skill. It can run any time. It is cross-cutting. It is not a starter option.

1.64.0: shows a task's `(branch: …)` and one Branches line from local git only.

1.68.0: the `Sub-branches:` and `left behind:` lines and `merged, reverted on <base> (<sha>)`, report only.

1.69.0: the `Promotion:` line under the Branches line, with the optional `pipeline runs` check.

1.88.0: command-only (`disable-model-invocation: true`). It runs only when you type [`/crav1-tasks-ready-to-build`](crav1-tasks-ready-to-build.md); the agent does not start it from a plain question, and its description no longer loads in every chat.

## Choice words

Exact words for bots and scripted runs (no `--flags`). A word in the invocation takes that choice without asking. A headless or bot run with no word stops and names the valid words.

| Question | Word | Means |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Also check the latest pipeline runs? | `pipeline runs` | check the latest successful Azure DevOps runs behind the Promotion line (read-only) |

## Runs when

You want to know which tasks can be built now, and why the others cannot. Called by the user with its slash command, any time (command-only).

## Prompts

Prompt budget: 0 (asks nothing). A prompt may hold several questions. See the asking rule in `crav1.mdc`.

## Reads

In short: `spec.md` open questions, `plan.md`, `tasks.md`, and `verify.md` per slice.

Reads, for one slice or every slice under `docs/specs/`, the open questions in `spec.md` with their `Blocks:`, `Asked:`, `Pending:`, and `Answered:` lines, the `Reviewed:` line and `## Risks` in `plan.md`, the task lines in `tasks.md` with their ticks and `(after: T#)`, and `verify.md` when it exists.

## Writes

In short: Nothing (a list in chat with its source).

Writes a list in the chat with summary counts, Ready, Blocked, Needs verify, a Done count, the next step, and its source.

## Does not

Leaves every file alone, and never reads Azure Boards.

Limits and exceptions: does not guess a dependency or a blocking link from task text. Where nothing is recorded it uses a fallback and marks the reason inferred. It writes no marks; review-plan, tighten-plan, plan-from-spec, and resolve-open-questions write them.
